cases.title: Published Stages formats columns and omits Stage Code without ref_id
steps: Inspect the Bidding Starts At and Bidding Ends At values.
cases.expected: Stage Code is absent when no row has ref_id. Stage Title, Pending Actions, Participants, Bidding Starts At, and Bidding Ends At are shown. Participants use active/total values and missing values show 0. Dates use DATE_TIME formatting and missing dates show '-'.
cases.setup: Use a project with at least one published stage without ref_id, one stage with pending actions, and stages with and without bidding dates.
gaps: Verify Participants values use the active/total format for each row.
Verify populated Bidding Starts At and Bidding Ends At values use DATE_TIME formatting.
Verify the exact rows and values displayed in the Published Stages table.
unconfirmed label "-" (expect_text) — not among the labels known from the app nor in the case

cases.title: Line Items and Participants show response counts
steps: Refresh the project details page after changing either response count.
cases.expected: Each panel header shows its response count tag. After refresh, the tags reflect the latest line-item and participant response counts.
cases.setup: Use a project whose line-item response count and participant response count are known.
gaps: Changing either the line-item or participant response count
Refreshing the project details page after changing a response count and proving the updated tags persist

cases.title: Ask Clara completes the analyze-data action and redirects
steps: Wait for the action to complete.
cases.expected: The app shows 'Awarding initiated successfully, redirecting to awarding flow...' and navigates to the returned redirect_url.
cases.setup: Use a project with an analyze_data todo and a returned redirect_url.
gaps: Exact selection or completion of the internal "analyze-data" action if it is not exposed with that visible label
The exact redirect_url returned by the action

cases.title: Line item delete requires the exact confirmation
steps: Open the row menu under Actions for the target line item.
cases.expected: A confirmation appears stating 'Are you sure you want to delete <title> line item with <qty> quantity'. The line item remains present because deletion is not confirmed.
cases.setup: Use a project with a line item whose title is known and whose quantity is known.
gaps: The exact dynamic confirmation text containing the generated line-item title and quantity cannot be asserted because the case provides neither value.
The specific target line item cannot be identified because no product or title is provided.

cases.title: Overview displays project identity and conditional open-tender status
